champion.tips: JARVAN IV TIPS AND TRICKS Before ever using your E > Q combo, make sure you check the minimap. If you go in and the enemy Jungler shows up, you’re basically dead. In team fights, look to flank targets that are overextended and out of position. You have great gap closures, but you’ll find it hard to close the gap if the enemy knows where you are. Attack from the side when possible. Adapt your build path depending on what your team needs. Jarvan’s can go tank or damage.
champion.builds: THE BEST JARVAN IV BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR TOP IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Jarvan IV Top build, you should take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Grasp of the Undying as your keystone, followed by Shield Bash, Bone Plating and Overgrowth in the primary tree, as well as Legend: Haste and Coup de Grace in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Eclipse as your first item, followed by Plated Steelcaps and Winter's Approach. For your last 3 items, you should build Sundered Sky, Frozen Heart and finish with Spirit Visage. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 46.3% winrate over 67 matches played. Optional Your second option for Jarvan IV Top build would be to take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Conqueror as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, and Relentless Hunter with Sudden Impact in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Eclipse, which you should build first, followed by Plated Steelcaps as your second item and Sundered Sky as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Black Cleaver, Spirit Visage and Unending Despair. The skill order for this build is Q - E - W. In the current patch, this build has a 46.0% win rate over 50 matches. Situational Jarvan IV Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Jarvan IV build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Jarvan IV runes page.
